_comment: GENERATED by scripts/gen-lexicon.ts (trek-10) from the local Oracle index: the creature types that cards of the game's own sets print and the CR edition of lexicon.generated.json does not list yet (certain ones only: see printedCreatureEvidence). Regenerating keeps the types already listed, so an older index cannot take one away. Do not edit: run `npx tsx scripts/gen-lexicon.ts`. A test fails if the local index proves a type this file lacks, or this file lists one the index prints as another class's subtype (skipped on a machine without the index). Words only.
